headline: Pakistan and Sweden start discussions to modernize 1981 investment treaty
summary: Delegations from Pakistan and Sweden met in Islamabad to negotiate updates to their 1981 Bilateral Investment Treaty, aiming to foster private sector participation.
why: Bilateral Investment Treaties establish legal protections for cross-border foreign direct investment between signatory countries.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Modernizing investment framework agreements encourages private sector inflows.
